basis: RAW as-acquired SOLID food, kg per person per day (beverages excluded)
basis_note: This is the basis a camp STORE holds and procures against. It is NOT cooked served weight -- see ration_rates.json for the cooked quantities the kitchen issues.

training_data.source: BRIGHT Sri Lanka household survey, February 2025
training_data.filters: household_size <= 15; 0.1 < kg_day < 40; consumed rows with a unit conversion only
training_data.beverages: excluded -- drinking water is a separate allowance in ration_rates.json

metrics.note: Low R2 reflects lumpy household purchasing, not imprecise coefficients: the adult rate's 95 % interval is about +/- 4 %. Individual households buy in bulk; the per-band means are what the model estimates and they are estimated tightly.

caveats: BRIGHT measures acquisition, so waste, guests and food given away are included. For procurement that is closer to correct than pure intake.
About 27 % of consumed rows have no unit conversion factor and are dropped upstream, so household totals are slightly understated.
Household eating is not camp eating: a central kitchen wastes less than 6,802 separate homes.
